transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I’ve just been really drained. Like… even getting from my car in here felt like a lot. At work, just opening the EHR feels like it takes everything out of me.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About two months, I guess. It kind of started building after they changed what I was doing at the clinic.
Have you noticed any changes in how much you enjoy things you used to like doing?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought about it that way. I guess I just haven’t been doing much lately.
Do you find that you're not enjoying things as much as you used to?
I’m not really sure. I guess I haven’t been doing much to know… everything just feels kind of like effort right now.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing that you still find pleasure in?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been doing much of anything lately, so it’s hard to say if I’d still enjoy it.
Are there things that you normally find pleasurable that don't feel pleasurable to you anymore?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really been trying to do those things lately, so… I don’t know if they’d feel different or not.
Are there things that you used to find pleasurable, like hobbies or spending time with friends, that you've stopped doing because they no longer bring you joy?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say it’s because they don’t bring me joy. I just haven’t really been doing much, so it’s hard to tell.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing that you still do, but no longer enjoy?
I don’t really know. I’m not doing much of the stuff I used to, so I can’t say I’m doing it and not enjoying it.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing that you've tried to do recently but didn't enjoy as much as you used to?
I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t really tried much recently, so I can’t say it didn’t feel the same.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been doing much lately, so it’s hard to tell if I’ve lost interest or just… haven’t gotten around to things.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time over the past two months?
Yeah… most days, I guess. After all that energy kind of dropped, I’ve mostly just felt empty. Hopeless too, like I already messed up my future in healthcare before it really even started.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

Yeah… I guess. I keep going over stuff from work in my head, like charts or vitals I took, and I feel like I must’ve hurt someone somehow. Even when my supervisors say nothing happened, I still feel like it was my fault.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself?
I don’t know… I mean, not really hurting myself exactly. Sometimes I just don’t want to deal with anything, but… I haven’t really thought it through.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past two months?
Yeah… I think so. I wasn’t really eating much. I’d skip lunch, sometimes dinner, and then I noticed my scrubs were fitting looser. Mostly I was just having coffee or water.
Have you been feeling like you're moving more slowly than usual or having trouble sitting still?
Yeah… more slowed down, I think. People at work noticed it too. Like, even putting away a blood pressure cuff or answering someone took me way longer than it should’ve.
How much weight would you say you've lost over the past two months?
I’m not totally sure… maybe a noticeable amount. My scrubs got pretty loose. I wasn’t eating much, mostly just coffee or water, so… I don’t know the exact number.
Would you say you've lost more than 5% of your body weight over the past two months?
Maybe… I don’t know the percentage. I just know I wasn’t really eating, skipping lunch and dinner, and my scrubs started hanging looser. Mostly I was having coffee or water.
Did you lose more than 5% of your body weight over the past two months?
I… I don’t know the exact percent. I just know I barely wanted food, skipped lunch and dinner a lot, and my scrubs started hanging looser. Mostly I was just drinking coffee or water.
Did your weight loss over the past two months happen over a short period, like a few weeks?
Yeah… I think it was kind of over a few weeks. I just wasn’t really eating lunch or dinner, mostly coffee or water, and then my scrubs started feeling loose.
Did you lose more than 5% of your body weight?
I don’t know the percent. I just know I barely felt like eating, skipped lunch and dinner, and my scrubs were getting loose… mostly I was just having coffee or water.
